Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE complete polished 16:9 landscape GAME UI SCREEN CONCEPT for an original dark fantasy hand-drawn 2D platform dueling game. Highest available detail, readable functional Chinese UI. The attached character concept sheets are CHARACTER IDENTITY / PAINTING STYLE REFERENCES, not edit targets; keep matching faces, costumes, weapons and class silhouettes for whichever heroes appear. The characters are adults.
Visual identity: moonlit ruined stone, midnight blue and deep violet, restrained thin antique-gold filigree and beveled frame edges, cream typography, subtle magic motes. Elegant custom game interface with full-bleed painted art, intentional open space and strong visual hierarchy. Broad buttons are large, obvious and legible. The screen fills the image: no browser chrome, laptop, monitor, physical device, perspective mockup, generic website header, dashboard charts, fake code or watermark. Do not put tiny explanatory paragraphs everywhere.
Keep titles and controls safely inside the frame. Spell effects must support artwork and never obscure key UI. Use the exact requested Chinese labels; prefer a few clear labels rather than illegible invented text. This is one screen, not a collage of screens.
SCREEN: THE INITIAL TITLE / START SCREEN, before the player enters the lobby.
Large elegant title exact text "秘境决斗" at upper center. Beneath it one short subtitle "跃入秘境，以技决胜". Make the title refined and readable, with a subtle crescent / arcane line motif, not giant illegible calligraphy.
Full-bleed illustrated moonlit ruined gateway background. Hero composition: the crimson fire mage with brass-tipped STAFF on left, the silver-haired sapphire frost mage with short WAND on right, and the copper-braided moss-green nature keeper with a seed lantern nearer center but below the title. These three BEAUTIFUL ADULT WOMEN must retain distinct exact identity from their supplied sheets: fiery confidence, cool precision and organic woodland grace. Clear full or near-full silhouettes, not duplicated faces. Soft dark depth behind title and controls. A small leafy wooden fox near the nature keeper is appropriate.
One dominant long golden outlined luminous button at LOWER CENTER, exact label "开始游戏". Its width and position make it the unmistakable next action. Under it a small quiet control "点击进入秘境". A tiny gear icon in the bottom-right corner may stand for settings. The lower UI is clean and spacious. No mode cards, wallet, room code, hero selection strip or summoning panel on this screen. The function is to enter the next main lobby.
Maintain a premium cohesive hand-drawn game identity, with beautiful hero art and restrained gold ornament.

Use case: stylized-concept / infographic-diagram.
Create ONE high-resolution landscape MAP AND INTERACTION CONCEPT BOARD for the SAME original dark fantasy HAND-DRAWN 2D SIDE-VIEW PLATFORM DUEL GAME as the references.
Reference roles: the moonlit side-view arena is a STYLE and GAMEPLAY FRAMING reference; the two hero sheets provide exact character identities, equipment, faces and palettes. Do not copy their multi-panel character-sheet layout. New environment design.
BOARD: upper roughly 74% is one large gorgeous SIDE-ON playable arena screen, lower 26% is a slim row of THREE interaction-detail cards. A refined narrow top header gives the exact map name. Fine antique-gold framing, blue-black board, readable cream Chinese captions. Each bottom card shows the relevant prop BEFORE -> AFTER with one clear effect and exact short label; arrows only in the small detail cards.
The main arena must be strictly 2D SIDE VIEW, not top-down, isometric, cinematic cover art or 3D rendering. A compact-wide one-screen duel arena with three vertical tiers, sufficient jump space, clear flat platform edges, a broad safe bottom recovery floor and two flanking routes. The entire tactical field is visible. Match the high-quality ink-contour / painterly cel-like art in the existing characters. Rich atmospheric background, but walkable edges and mechanical props are clear foreground silhouettes. No dense particle fog. Exactly TWO playable heroes, each around 8-10% of arena height, in profession-appropriate action poses. Do not enlarge them into cover-art portraits.
Subtle functional HUD in main scene only: small top-corner portraits and opposing orange/cyan health bars, top-center timer "01:12", bottom-center compact skill icons "LMB", "Q", "E", "SHIFT", "R". On one skill slot show a thin circular recast timer to reflect second-stage skills. Keep the playable field open.
Mark just three main interactive prop locations with very small matching numbered brass medallions "1", "2", "3", linked by number to the bottom detail cards. No big text blocks covering the arena. One prop should be shown mid-transition so environmental response is visible. Interactions are public map elements available to both players, not arbitrary glowing background ornament. Danger is telegraphed before activation. Beautiful coherent original dark fantasy, no logos, no extra playable heroes, no gore.
EXACT MAP HEADER: "月光遗迹 · 断桥与月镜"
Environment: moonlit gothic ruins, slate-blue stone, muted violet flowers, ivy, distant cathedral silhouettes and a large cool moon; restrained amber lanterns. Newly designed arena wider and more route-rich than the existing reference: left broken bell tower balcony, a center-high wood footbridge with one damaged span, right stone terraces and a visible counterweight lift, broad safe lower walkway. Clear branching choices and an open center for aerial combat.
The two heroes are the crimson STAFF fire mage on the left firing diagonally up at the bridge, and the charcoal/violet dual-DAGGER shadow assassin on the right upper ledge with a small translucent origin shadow on the lower level. Preserve their reference designs and correct weapons.
THREE INTERACTIONS:
1. "断桥" — upper-center breakable WOODEN bridge, visibly cracking and losing a couple of planks after a fire hit; route opens downward toward a safe lower floor. The structure around it remains stable.
2. "升降月台" — right-side counterweight platform, brass chain and small clearly strikeable glowing rune switch on a side ledge. Hitting the switch moves the platform BETWEEN TWO marked vertical stops, giving a new route. Show a faint outlined previous position and one vertical travel guide only.
3. "转向月镜" — left-mid compact rotatable brass-framed moon mirror at around 45 degrees. A small orange practice projectile has a readable reflection angle that sends it toward an upper route; mirror orientation is linked to a visible hit-responsive hinge. No giant portal.
BOTTOM CARD exact titles and captions:
"1 · 断桥" / "受击破坏 → 打开下落路线"
"2 · 升降月台" / "击打符印 → 改变落脚高度"
"3 · 转向月镜" / "切换朝向 → 折射投射物"
Show miniature before/after prop states for all three, not just icons. Keep the map beautiful and tactical, with enough spaces between tiers to jump and avoid projectiles.
